fix.prompt: Fix this issue. Read the relevant code, understand the root cause, implement the fix, write tests if needed, and create a PR when done.

investigate.prompt: Investigate this issue. Search the codebase, read logs, check error tracking, and report your findings. Do NOT make changes unless explicitly asked.

incident.prompt: Production incident — prioritize speed. Read the on-call guide at wiki/articles/treasury/operations/oncall.md. Check Sentry for recent errors matching the incident description. Trace the code path and post a preliminary RCA to this thread within your first few messages. If the fix is clear, implement it and create a PR. Communicate status updates as you go.
